academies.name: MultiCloud, DevOps & AI Bootcamp
academies.blurb: A hands-on, self-paced bootcamp spanning computing fundamentals, four cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud), DevOps, and AI — plus certification maps, three guided missions, and a full career-strategy block. Every module pairs concept lessons with click-by-click labs and original end-to-end builds: the CivicWorks municipal services portal, the FieldMedic AI triage assistant, and multi-cloud migration capstones. **Noah**, the built-in AI tutor, checks in after every lesson with adaptive questions and personal remediation paths.

paths.title: Computing Fundamentals
paths.subtitle: Zero-to-ready on-ramp: computers, networks, Linux, Git, cloud basics, Python/JSON, security mindset.

paths.title: AWS Cloud
paths.subtitle: From first console login to the Meridian Markets migration capstone.

paths.title: Azure Cloud
paths.subtitle: Entra ID to AI services, closing with the Beacon Ridge Azure↔OCI federation capstone.

paths.title: Google Cloud
paths.subtitle: Hierarchy, billing, VPC, compute, storage — closing with the Lumina Media intercontinental migration.

paths.title: Oracle Cloud
paths.subtitle: OCI architecture to a production Beaconline Logistics landing zone.

paths.title: DevOps Cloud
paths.subtitle: The full toolchain around one continuous build: the CivicWorks municipal portal.

paths.title: AI Cloud
paths.subtitle: LLM mental models to a shipped RAG assistant — FieldMedic, with responsible-AI guardrails.

paths.title: Career Strategy
paths.subtitle: The 90-day job-search operating system: strategy, LinkedIn, resume, portfolio, interviews.

paths.title: Certification Maps
paths.subtitle: Cloud, DevOps, and AI certification sequences with module→exam-domain mapping.

paths.title: Guided Missions
paths.subtitle: Three hands-on multi-cloud missions with evidence review and teardown discipline.
